question: Among the given options, _______ is the method of irrigation.
solution:
The correct answer is a__** canal.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• ** A canal is a method of irrigation that involves the use of artificial waterways to supply water to crops.** This method is widely used in agriculture to irrigate large areas of land.
 
• **Double cropping** is a practice of growing two crops in the same field in a single growing season. This method is used to maximize the use of land and increase crop yield.
 
• ** Ploughing** is a process of turning over the soil to prepare it for planting. This method is used to loosen the soil and remove weeds, making it easier for crops to grow.
 
• Step cultivation is a method of farming that involves the creation of terraced fields on steep slopes. This method is used to prevent soil erosion and conserve water.
 
• It is important to choose the right method of irrigation depending on the type of crop, soil, and climate conditions.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• ** Double cropping:** This practice is common in areas with a long growing season and mild winters, such as the southern United States.
 
• **Ploughing:** This method has been used for centuries and is still widely used today, although modern ploughs are more efficient and require less labor.
 
• **Step cultivation: **This method is commonly used in mountainous regions, such as Southeast Asia and the Andes Mountains in South America.
 
• ** Canal: **Canals can be either natural or artificial and are used to transport water from one place to another. They are commonly used in irrigation systems to supply water to crops.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• Furrow irrigation-

 
 
• Furrow irrigation is a method of laying out the water channels in such a way where gravity plays the role of providing just enough water for suitable plants to grow. It is usually made by the planned placement of ridges and furrows. It is a kind of surface irrigation system.
 
 
 
• Sprinkler irrigation-
 
 
• There is no requirement of using many areas of your field for setting up sprinkler irrigation. The interference with cultivation for setting up the sprinkler irrigation is very less.
 
• Frequent application of water can be supplied to the plants automatically. The water distribution will always be equal.
 
 
 
• Drip Irrigation-
 
 
• It drips water straight into the root zone and also minimizes evaporation. There are some networks that are used to distribute water equally among all the plants. These are valves, pipes, tubing, and emitters.
 
• Due to improper water supply, fertilizers and nutrients cannot reach the roots of every plant. Drip Irrigation system helps it to reach effectively.
 
• Contour farming –
 
• Contour cultivation (contour farming, contour plowing) is a sustainable way of farming where farmers plant crops across or perpendicular to slopes to follow the contours of a slope of a field. This arrangement of plants breaks up the flow of water and makes it harder for soil erosion to occur.
 
• Plowing and planting across slope contours create man-made water breaks that not only allow enough time for the water to enter the soil, but also to settles the topsoil without washing it down the slope.
